title: nurt-value/1
description: Values, dynamic records, typed records and errors of the Nurt language.

oneOf.description:
Integer outside the 64-bit range, as decimal digits with an optional
leading `-`; produced when reading documents.

Number kept as its exact source text because the binary form would
change it (for example `1.10` or `1e400` read from a document).
Point in time in UTC with nanosecond precision.
Date or time of day read from a document, kept in its source form.

Path in canonical form: `/` as separator, absolute, upper-case drive
letter, or a provider path such as `env:/PATH`.
Key path inside a structured document, for example `scripts.test`.
Value of an enumeration, for example `directory`.
Record of a known kind with ordered fields.

Value.description:
Value of the language.

The JSON form carries the type in `"t"` and the payload in `"v"` (see the
module documentation).

Size.description:
Size in bytes.

The text form (`12.4kb`) belongs to the language implementation; the
JSON form is the number of bytes.

Duration.description:
Signed duration in milliseconds.

The text form (`1h30m`) belongs to the language implementation; the JSON
form is the number of milliseconds.

Instant.description: Point in time in UTC, RFC 3339 with the suffix `Z`.

text.description: Text exactly as in the document.

Date.description:
Date or time of day as written in a structured document (TOML, YAML,
property lists), kept in its source form so that writing it back does
not change it.

oneOf.description: Date and time with an offset, for example `2026-11-21T10:00:00+01:00`.
Date and time without an offset, for example `2026-11-21T10:00:00`.
Time of day only, for example `10:00:00`.

DateKind.description: Form of a date or time read from a document.

flags.description: Flags; omitted from JSON when empty.

Bytes.description: Binary data, standard base64 with padding.

fields.description: Fields in order; a field that has no value is absent.

oneOf.description: Value at a key path in a structured document (`read key:`, `query`).
Row of a table, CSV file or SQLite query (`sql`, `split`).
Node of a syntax tree (`search mode: syntax`).
Change of one file within an effect.
Result of a finished program run (`run`).
Status of a path in a repository (`git.status`).
Response that an HTTP request received (`http.request`).
Volume as seen by the journal (`journal.space`).
Finding of an analysis or review (`analyze.check`, `git.review`).

Effect of a changing or running stage; the fields are those of the
effect report.

State and limits of the operation journal (`journal.status`,
`journal.limits`).
Field of the records in a pipeline (`describe`).
Line annotated with its last commit (`git.blame`).
Description of a symbol at a position (`code.hover`).
Code action offered by a language server (`code.actions`).
Planned edit of a rename (`code.rename` preview).
One run of a scheduled task (`schedule.history`).
Analysis tool found in a project (`analyze.tools`).
Update of a reference by a transfer (`git.fetch`, `git.push`).
Effect of an operation on a repository (part `git` of an effect).
Preserved copy of a deleted branch or stash entry (`git.branch`).

Record of computed or source-defined fields without a fixed kind
(`select` with computed fields, `parse`, `windows.cim`).

RecordKind.description:
Kind of a record.

Every kind has a stable name used in programs, in the catalog
(`input` and `output` of commands) and in JSON.

TypedRecord.description:
Typed record of any kind.

The JSON form is `{"kind": "entry", "record": {…}}`.

name.description: Last component of the path, in NFC.

extension.description: Last extension, without the leading period.

exists.description: Whether the entry exists; set in the result of `info`.

size.description: Size in bytes; for directories as reported by the system.

mode.description: Permission bits in octal, for example `0644`.

encoding.description: Detected encoding of a text file.

line_ending.description: Line endings of a text file.

bom.description: Whether the text starts with a byte order mark.

etag.description: Entity tag of the content at the time of reading.

raw_name.description:
Name as bytes when it is not valid Unicode or differs from the
NFC form.

case_alias.description: Actual spelling on a volume that ignores case.

portability.description:
Portability problems of the name, for example
`windows_reserved_name`.

depth.description: Depth below the root of the listing.

relative.description: Path relative to the root of the listing.

total_size.description: Total size of a directory tree.

file_count.description: Number of files in a directory tree.

rank.description: Similarity rank of a fuzzy search.

match_count.description: Number of matches in the file.

error.description: Error that kept the entry from being read completely.

Entry.description:
File system entry: file, directory, link or another object.

For an entry that does not exist (`exists: false` in the result of
`info`), `size` is zero and `modified` is the Unix epoch.

Path.description:
Path in canonical form, used for the path fields of typed records.

Canonical form: `/` as separator, absolute, upper-case drive letter
(`C:/Users/user`), UNC paths as `//server/share`, provider paths with a
prefix (`registry:/HKCU/Software`, `env:/PATH`,
`archive:/home/user/a.zip!/dir/file`). Normalisation is done by the
language implementation; this type only carries the text.

oneOf.description: Directory; keys of the Windows registry are shown as directories.
Symbolic link, junction or other link.
Device, socket, FIFO or another special object.

EntryType.description: Type of a file system entry or of an archive member.

oneOf.description: No line ending in the text.

text.description: Text, possibly limited to a range.

size.description: Size of the file in bytes.

bom.description: Whether the file starts with a byte order mark.

ranges.description: Ranges of lines when several were requested.

total_lines.description: Total number of lines of the file.

unchanged.description: The file did not change since the given entity tag.

truncated.description: The text was cut at a limit.

pages_total.description: Number of pages of the document.

since_missing.description: The content given with `since:` was not available.

diff.description: Difference against the content given with `since:`.

decompressed_from.description: Compressed file the text was read from.

revision.description:
Full identifier of the repository revision the content was read
from.

ContentImage.description: Image carried by a content record.

etag.description: Entity tag of the notebook file.

outputs.description: Outputs as stored in the notebook.

outputs_summary.description: Number and kinds of outputs, without their content.

end_column.description: Column after the symbol on the last line.

lines.description: Lines with the prefixes `+`, `-` and space.

moved.description: Blocks of lines moved within the difference.

DiffUnit.description: Unit in which a difference compares content.

from_path.description: File the lines were removed from.

to_path.description: File the lines were added to.

end.description: Byte offset after the line, without the line ending.

range_index.description: Index of the requested range the line belongs to.

start.description: Byte offset of the match from the start of the file.

groups.description: Capture groups by number; `null` for a group that did not match.

count.description: Number of matches in the file (`output: counts`).

pattern.description: Index of the pattern in a list of patterns.

end_line.description: Last line of a multi-line match.

end_column.description: Column after the match on the last line.

summarized.description: Only counted, not shown in full.

oneOf.description:
Backtracking engine with a step limit, used for look-around and
back-references.

RegexEngine.description: Engine that evaluated a regular expression.

format.description: Format of the document, for example `json`.

value_type.description: Type of the value in the document.

start.description: Byte offset of the value from the start of the file.

document.description: Index of the document in a file with several documents.

alias_of.description: Anchor this value is an alias of.

Item.description: Value at a key path in a structured document.

oneOf.description: Number with a fraction or an exponent.

ValueType.description: Type of a value in a structured document.

table.description: Table or statement the row comes from.

to.description: New path of a move or a copy.

Reason why the change cannot be undone, for example

State before a change of the action `state`, for example
`running`.

after.description: State after a change of the action `state`.

oneOf.description: A program with an effect outside the local file system was run.
References of a remote repository were updated or fetched.
A network request that changes remote state was sent.
A database was changed without a preserved copy.

A correction is possible but touches a target of a change;

A checkpoint has no saved index, or its content does not match after
a restore; the paths are listed.

A worktree is unknown, is the main worktree, is locked or contains
the working directory.

The configuration of the repository is not valid: a value cannot be
parsed or a required key is missing.
An internal error; the report is complete up to this point.

length.description: Number of characters of the erroneous fragment.

stage.description: Execution stage in which the error occurred.

oneOf.description: `0`, parse: text to surface tree with form correction; no effect.

`1`, bind: binding to the catalog, types, defaults and the effect
class; no effect.
`2`, read: sources and transformations; reads only.
`3`, check: assertions before the effect; no effect.
`4`, plan: targets and the planned effect; previews end here.
`5`, apply: the effect, recorded in the journal.
`5a`, after: stages on the records of the effect; the effect stays.

`6`, verify: the verification pipeline; failure rolls the effect
back.

Stage.description:
Execution stage of a program, in execution order.

The JSON form is the stage number as text: `"0"` to `"7"` and `"5a"`. The
executor uses the same type for its execution steps
([`crate::stage::ExecStep`]). The set of stages is fixed by the language.

column.description: Column, from 1, in Unicode scalar values.

end_column.description: Column directly after the fragment on the last line.

byte.description: Byte offset from the start of the file.

Location.description:
Position in a data file, as opposed to [`At`], which points into the
program.

rank.description: Rank, from 1 for the most likely candidate.

ref.description: Identifier for `accept`, valid for a limited time.

program.description: Complete program text of the candidate.

Candidate.description:
Ranked ready program offered instead of an ambiguous or uncorrectable
one.
